What is ruling span and why is it important?

An overhead line with stranded copper conductor of size $7/3.45\text{ mm}$ and cross sectional area $64.55\text{ mm}^2$ has a span of $160\text{ m}$ of between level supports. The sag is $3.96\text{ m}$ at $-5.5^\circ\text{C}$ with $9.53\text{ mm}$ thick ice coating and wind pressure of $40\text{ kgf/m}^2$ of projected area. Considering the weight of the conductor to be $0.594\text{ kgf/m}$, modulus of elasticity to be $12700\text{ kgf/mm}^2$, coefficient of linear expansion to be $1.7 \times 10^{-5}/^\circ\text{C}$ and density of the ice to be $913.5\text{ kgf}$, calculate the temperature at which the sag will remain the same under conditions of no ice and no wind.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of suspension insulators.
Describe the features of All Aluminum Alloy Conductor.
Discuss the functions of sheath and armouring of a cable.

The capacitance measured between any two cores of a three phase belted cable is $0.3\text{ }\mu\text{F/km}$. Calculate the charging kVAr taken by a $5\text{ km}$ length of this cable when connected to an $11\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ Hz}$ supply.
What are the different types of faults that occur in a cable? How are they identified?

rows.label: Group-A — Answer any three of the following questions

rows.textLatex: Explain why the inductance of bundled conductor lines is less than single conductor lines.

rows.topic: Magnetic Flux Linkage of Solid Conductor & Group
rows.textLatex: Write down the expression for the magnetic flux linkage of a solid round conductor, considering all flux upto a distance $d$. Hence derive an expression for the flux linkage of any conductor in a group of several conductors carrying a network current zero.
Derive the expression for the capacitance of three phase, asymmetrically spaced and transposed double circuit line.

Fig. 1 below shows the arrangement of a single phase double circuit overhead transmission line. Conductors $a, a'$ form one circuit and conductors $b, b'$ form return circuit. If the diameter of each conductor is $2.2\text{ cm}$ determine the total inductance per km per phase of the line.

rows.topic: Effect of Ground on Three-Phase Line Capacitance
rows.textLatex: Discuss with the help of mathematical derivation, how ground affects the capacitance of a three phase, asymmetrically spaced and transposed overhead transmission line conductors.

Explain with suitable derivation how transposition of power transmission line helps to reduce electromagnetic interference on communication lines. Under what conditions transposition of power transmission lines will not be effective?
What do you understand by tuned power lines? Determine the length of a $50\text{ Hz}$ transmission line for tuning.

rows.label: Group-B — Answer any two of the following questions

rows.textLatex: What do you understand by performance of transmission lines? Explain 'lumped parameter' and 'distributed parameter' of a transmission line.
Determine the velocity of travelling waves in overhead transmission lines. Why the velocity of the same is less in underground cables?
Determine the equivalent ABCD parameters of two transmission lines when they are connected in i) cascade and ii) parallel.

The resistance, inductance and capacitance of a three phase $132\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ Hz}$ transmission line are $0.2\text{ }\Omega$, $1.3\text{ mH}$ and $0.01\text{ }\mu\text{F}$ respectively. Determine the magnitude of the incident voltage and reflected voltage at the receiving end under no-load condition.
Define voltage regulation of a transmission line.

rows.topic: Transmission Line Voltage Regulation & Shunt Compensation
rows.textLatex: A $30\text{ km}$ long three phase overhead transmission line delivers $2\text{ MW}$ at $11\text{ kV}$ at a power factor $0.95$ lagging. Line loss is $5\%$ of the power delivered. Line inductance is $1.5\text{ mH}$ per phase per km. Calculate (a) sending end voltage and voltage regulation (b) power factor of the load to make the voltage regulation zero with the help of relevant phasor diagram and (c) the value of capacitor to be connected at the receiving end to reduce regulation to zero.
